hero.subtitle: Discover the new avant-garde collection where bold streetwear meets timeless luxury tailoring.

about.title: The
about.description: Founded on the principles of unapologetic elegance and avant-garde structure, our atelier has spent over a decade redefining modern luxury. We believe in the power of silhouette, the necessity of impeccable tailoring, and the bold statement of stark contrast.

timeline.title: Atelier Foundation
timeline.description: The brand was born in a small studio in Paris, focusing entirely on bespoke tailoring and avant-garde silhouettes.

timeline.title: First Runway
timeline.description: Debuted the first full collection at Paris Fashion Week, gaining international recognition for the stark black & red palette.

timeline.title: Global Expansion
timeline.description: Opened flagship stores in Tokyo, New York, and Milan. Expanding into luxury accessories.

testimonials.quote: Maison's pieces are a masterclass in structural elegance. The FW27 collection single-handedly redefined how we style avant-garde looks for the red carpet.
testimonials.name: Eleanor Vance

testimonials.quote: Working with this atelier is a revelation. The uncompromising quality and dramatic silhouettes always make my clients the center of attention.
testimonials.name: Julian Sterling

testimonials.quote: Our boutique clients demand the extraordinary. The capsule collections from Maison consistently exceed expectations with their striking red and black palette.
testimonials.name: Clara Dupont
